sections.title: update_link_info SELECT rewritten from parameterized query to string-interpolated IN clause
sections.rationale: The single hunk replaces a parameterized SELECT with an f-string that interpolates user-supplied URLs directly into the SQL, introducing a SQL injection vulnerability in the link-info update path.
